# TRAIN: BEST CLUSTERING + SUPERMARKET CONDITIONAL GRAPH
not going with - worse result by train than pure clastering 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# best clustering = kmeans_compact_v2, k = 8
# graph = supermarket conditional rarity

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )


kmeans_train_v2 <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_kmeans_v2_raw <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_kmeans_v2 <- scale(X_kmeans_v2_raw)

set.seed(123)
k <- 8

kmeans_model_v2 <- kmeans(
  X_kmeans_v2,
  centers = k,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

kmeans_train_v2$cluster_id <- kmeans_model_v2$cluster
centers_v2 <- kmeans_model_v2$centers

assigned_distances_v2 <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_kmeans_v2), seq_len(nrow(X_kmeans_v2))),
  kmeans_model_v2$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers_v2[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

kmeans_train_v2$distance_to_centroid <- assigned_distances_v2

cluster_sizes_v2 <- table(kmeans_model_v2$cluster)

kmeans_train_v2 <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes_v2[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )


dept_data <- long_data %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

pairs <- dept_data %>%
  inner_join(dept_data, by = "transaction_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  transmute(
    transaction_id,
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

dept_counts <- dept_data %>%
  dplyr::count(department_name, name = "dept_count")

pair_counts <- pairs %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_1, dept_2, name = "pair_count")

pair_conditional <- pair_counts %>%
  left_join(
    dept_counts %>% rename(dept_1 = department_name, dept_1_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    dept_counts %>% rename(dept_2 = department_name, dept_2_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_2_given_1 = pair_count / dept_1_count,
    p_1_given_2 = pair_count / dept_2_count,
    conditional_strength = (p_2_given_1 + p_1_given_2) / 2,
    conditional_rarity = -log(conditional_strength)
  )

graph_train <- pairs %>%
  left_join(
    pair_conditional %>%
      select(dept_1, dept_2, conditional_strength, conditional_rarity),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    graph_score = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# baskets with <2 departments get graph_score = 0
graph_train_full <- basket_data %>%
  select(transaction_id) %>%
  left_join(graph_train, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    graph_score = replace_na(graph_score, 0)
  )


train_combo <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_train_v2 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    graph_train_full,
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid),
    graph_score_01 = percent_rank(graph_score),
    combined_kmeans_graph_score =
      0.75 * distance_to_centroid_01 +
      0.25 * graph_score_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_kmeans_graph_score))

top_150_kmeans_graph_train <- train_combo %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_graph_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_graph_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_graph_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_graph_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_graph_train$graph_score)
summary(top_150_kmeans_graph_train$cluster_size)

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_graph_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_graph_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# TRAIN: IF1 + SUPERMARKET CONDITIONAL GRAPH
not going with, worse than pure IF

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(isotree)

# TRAIN: IF1 + SUPERMARKET CONDITIONAL GRAPH
# IF1 = compact IF + price_deviation
# graph = supermarket conditional rarity

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )


basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      max(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )

if_train_if1 <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_if1_raw <- if_train_if1 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_if1 <- scale(X_if1_raw)

if_model_if1 <- isolation.forest(
  as.matrix(X_if1),
  ntrees = 300,
  sample_size = 512,
  ndim = 1,
  nthreads = 1
)

if_train_if1$if_score <- predict(
  if_model_if1,
  as.matrix(X_if1),
  type = "score"
)


dept_data <- long_data %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

pairs <- dept_data %>%
  inner_join(dept_data, by = "transaction_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  transmute(
    transaction_id,
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

dept_counts <- dept_data %>%
  dplyr::count(department_name, name = "dept_count")

pair_counts <- pairs %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_1, dept_2, name = "pair_count")

pair_conditional <- pair_counts %>%
  left_join(
    dept_counts %>% rename(dept_1 = department_name, dept_1_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    dept_counts %>% rename(dept_2 = department_name, dept_2_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_2_given_1 = pair_count / dept_1_count,
    p_1_given_2 = pair_count / dept_2_count,
    conditional_strength = (p_2_given_1 + p_1_given_2) / 2,
    conditional_rarity = -log(conditional_strength)
  )

graph_train <- pairs %>%
  left_join(
    pair_conditional %>%
      select(dept_1, dept_2, conditional_strength, conditional_rarity),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    graph_score = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

graph_train_full <- basket_data %>%
  select(transaction_id) %>%
  left_join(graph_train, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    graph_score = replace_na(graph_score, 0)
  )


if1_graph_train <- if_train_if1 %>%
  left_join(graph_train_full, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    if_score_01 = percent_rank(if_score),
    graph_score_01 = percent_rank(graph_score),
    combined_if1_graph_score =
      0.65 * if_score_01 +
      0.35 * graph_score_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_if1_graph_score))

top_150_if1_graph_train <- if1_graph_train %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_if1_graph_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_if1_graph_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_if1_graph_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_if1_graph_train$price_deviation)
summary(top_150_if1_graph_train$if_score)
summary(top_150_if1_graph_train$graph_score)

write.csv(
  top_150_if1_graph_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_if1_graph_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# TRAIN: BEST CLUSTERING + CASHIER CONDITIONAL GRAPH
# worse than pure, not going based on train

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# best clustering = kmeans_compact_v2, k = 8
# graph = cashier conditional rarity

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)


long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    top_3_price_share = {
      p <- sort(price, decreasing = TRUE)
      if (sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        sum(head(p, 3), na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max_price / total_price, NA_real_)
  )

dept_share <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::count(transaction_id, department, name = "dept_items") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_department_share = max(dept_items) / sum(dept_items),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(dept_share, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    items_per_department = total_items / unique_departments
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(
    expected_price_given_items = predict(model_price, newdata = basket_data),
    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )


kmeans_train_v2 <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    avg_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    sd_price,
    max_price_share,
    top_3_price_share,
    unique_departments,
    dominant_department_share,
    items_per_department,
    price_deviation
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sd_price = replace_na(sd_price, median(sd_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    top_3_price_share = replace_na(top_3_price_share, median(top_3_price_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dominant_department_share = replace_na(dominant_department_share, median(dominant_department_share, na.rm = TRUE)),
    items_per_department = replace_na(items_per_department, median(items_per_department, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_deviation = replace_na(price_deviation, median(price_deviation, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

X_kmeans_v2_raw <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_kmeans_v2 <- scale(X_kmeans_v2_raw)

set.seed(123)
k <- 8

kmeans_model_v2 <- kmeans(
  X_kmeans_v2,
  centers = k,
  nstart = 20,
  iter.max = 100
)

kmeans_train_v2$cluster_id <- kmeans_model_v2$cluster
centers_v2 <- kmeans_model_v2$centers

assigned_distances_v2 <- map2_dbl(
  split(as.data.frame(X_kmeans_v2), seq_len(nrow(X_kmeans_v2))),
  kmeans_model_v2$cluster,
  ~ {
    row_vec <- as.numeric(.x[1, ])
    center_vec <- centers_v2[.y, ]
    sqrt(sum((row_vec - center_vec)^2))
  }
)

kmeans_train_v2$distance_to_centroid <- assigned_distances_v2

cluster_sizes_v2 <- table(kmeans_model_v2$cluster)

kmeans_train_v2 <- kmeans_train_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_size = as.numeric(cluster_sizes_v2[as.character(cluster_id)])
  )


lines_cashier <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/cashier_data.csv", warn = FALSE)

cashier_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines_cashier),
  basket = lines_cashier
)

cashier_long <- cashier_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    price >= 0
  )

cashier_dept_data <- cashier_long %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

cashier_pairs <- cashier_dept_data %>%
  inner_join(cashier_dept_data, by = "transaction_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  transmute(
    transaction_id,
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

cashier_dept_counts <- cashier_dept_data %>%
  dplyr::count(department_name, name = "dept_count")

cashier_pair_counts <- cashier_pairs %>%
  dplyr::count(dept_1, dept_2, name = "pair_count")

cashier_pair_conditional <- cashier_pair_counts %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_dept_counts %>% rename(dept_1 = department_name, dept_1_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_1"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_dept_counts %>% rename(dept_2 = department_name, dept_2_count = dept_count),
    by = "dept_2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_2_given_1 = pair_count / dept_1_count,
    p_1_given_2 = pair_count / dept_2_count,
    conditional_strength = (p_2_given_1 + p_1_given_2) / 2,
    conditional_rarity = -log(conditional_strength)
  )

supermarket_dept_data <- long_data %>%
  select(transaction_id, department_name) %>%
  distinct()

supermarket_pairs <- supermarket_dept_data %>%
  inner_join(supermarket_dept_data, by = "transaction_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(department_name.x < department_name.y) %>%
  transmute(
    transaction_id,
    dept_1 = department_name.x,
    dept_2 = department_name.y
  )

cashier_graph_train <- supermarket_pairs %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_pair_conditional %>%
      select(dept_1, dept_2, conditional_strength, conditional_rarity),
    by = c("dept_1", "dept_2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    conditional_rarity = replace_na(
      conditional_rarity,
      max(cashier_pair_conditional$conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    cashier_graph_score = mean(conditional_rarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cashier_graph_train_full <- basket_data %>%
  select(transaction_id) %>%
  left_join(cashier_graph_train, by = "transaction_id") %>%
  mutate(
    cashier_graph_score = replace_na(cashier_graph_score, 0)
  )


train_combo <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    kmeans_train_v2 %>%
      select(transaction_id, cluster_id, cluster_size, distance_to_centroid),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cashier_graph_train_full,
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_to_centroid_01 = percent_rank(distance_to_centroid),
    cashier_graph_score_01 = percent_rank(cashier_graph_score),
    combined_kmeans_cashier_graph_score =
      0.75 * distance_to_centroid_01 +
      0.25 * cashier_graph_score_01
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(combined_kmeans_cashier_graph_score))

top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train <- train_combo %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train$distance_to_centroid)
summary(top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train$cashier_graph_score)
summary(top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train$cluster_size)

write.csv(
  top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_kmeans_cashier_graph_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)


long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  mutate(item_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(
      sum(time, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price_share = ifelse(
      sum(price, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      max(price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_price <- lm(total_price ~ total_items, data = basket_data)

basket_data <- basket_data %>%
  mutate(

    price_deviation = total_price - expected_price_given_items
  )
```
